trigger: Initial sweep or a subsequent completed refinement round has no qualified balanced protective lambda, or efficacy/geometry evidence remains unresolved

cases.condition: The highest at least three tested positive lambdas completed stably with active EWC, retention remains below the +1pp threshold, no known numerical divergence is above the stable edge, and these points do not violate the predefined new-task/mean-accuracy cost limits
cases.action: Expand positive lambda logarithmically from the highest completed value by sqrt(10) and 10, within the supported upper bound; inspect this round before expanding again

cases.condition: Some positive lambdas improve retention but none meet the balanced criteria
cases.action: Densify adjacent weak/strong-protection and acceptable/unacceptable-new-task transitions; also cover the nearest-to-qualified finite points to avoid assuming monotonicity

cases.condition: A higher tested lambda diverged numerically after a lower stable lambda
cases.action: Refine between the stable lambda and nearest higher diverged lambda; do not blindly expand beyond the known divergent boundary or treat divergence as strong protection

cases.condition: The smallest tested positive lambda is stable but causes excessive new-task or mean-accuracy loss
cases.action: Probe smaller positive lambda using divide-by-sqrt(10) and divide-by-10, within supported bounds; never take log(0)

cases.condition: EWC loss/gradient wiring is invalid, baseline is missing, or code/data/OOM/receipt failure prevents valid comparison
cases.action: Audit or repair the implementation/integration failure first, keeping a separate source revision and valid paired baseline if training logic changes; do not disguise it as a failed lambda point or fix it only by increasing lambda

local_refinement.candidate_ranking_when_no_threshold_cros: Among finite active points minimize max(0,1-delta_a21)+max(0,-5-delta_a22)+max(0,-delta_A2), then maximize A2; inspect their adjacent intervals

supported_lambda_bounds.note: Operational search bounds; upper bound matches current trainer validation. Do not silently change scientific settings to escape a numerical boundary.

candidate_representation: Use canonical finite numeric values and collision-free IDs; integer rounding only if still strictly interior and unique. Values below1/noninteger points require an isolated wrapper that supports them, not editing the active int-name sweep wrapper.
selection_pool: All valid completed points from the initial sweep and completed refinement rounds; preserve every negative and divergent observation

stop_or_continue.qualified_candidate_exists: Use the existing protected-candidate ranking to lock one lambda_star, then release the four-row plan
stop_or_continue.still_unqualified_with_unresolved_interv: Propose another refinement round; there is no automatic one-round-only stop
stop_or_continue.boundary_resolution: Do not infinitely subdivide an interval once U/L<=1.10 or distinct valid candidates cannot be represented. Examine remaining unresolved intervals or justified range extensions first.
stop_or_continue.no_admissible_region_left: If all evidence-supported intervals are resolved and supported expansion is exhausted or blocked by numerical instability, report no demonstrated qualifying range at this fixed protocol, keep lambda_star unset and four-row reruns pending; do not lower thresholds or claim universal nonexistence
